title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 14 Main Street in Brockport, New York, as the "Staff Sergeant Nicholas J. Reid Post Office Building".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 14 Main Street in Brockport, New York, as the "Staff Sergeant Nicholas J. Reid Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names a post office in Brockport, New York, after Staff Sergeant Nicholas J. Reid.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service building at 14 Main Street in Brockport, New York, as the "Staff Sergeant Nicholas J. Reid Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its hours.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on June 9, 2014, when it was signed.
